Daniel (Sales): Need quick policy check. My partner had an unexpected family emergency back home and I booked a same-day return for them so I could stay and finish client workshops. Can I expense their ticket?

Sasha (People Ops): Sorry to hear that. Short answer: companion travel is only covered in limited compassionate cases and typically requires pre-approval. Since this was urgent, we can consider an exception. We'll need documentation and manager sign-off.

Daniel (Sales): I booked an economy ticket on my card yesterday (flight cost $420). Manager (Aisha) verbally approved at the time and confirmed in DM. I attached screenshots of the airline booking and my partner's boarding pass. What else do you need?

Liam (Finance): Docs we need: itemized ticket receipt showing passenger name, proof of emergency (family hospital note or obituary or equivalent), manager approval captured in the expense notes, and a short rationale from you. We also need to confirm this wasn't leisure or discretionary. If approved, we'll reimburse up to the equivalent of an economy fare on the most direct itinerary.

Priya (Legal): Also flag: if the companion ticket creates a taxable benefit for the employee under local law, payroll may need to report it. People Ops + Finance will coordinate any tax reporting. If the employee had other options (e.g., using miles) we should note that.

Sasha (People Ops): Policy process: submit as exception in Expensify, tag "compassionate exception", attach emergency documentation and manager approval. People Ops will review and sign-off; Finance will then process. We ask employees to submit within 30 days where possible.

Daniel (Sales): Uploaded: ticket receipt, boarding pass, screenshot of Aisha's DM approving. Family hospital statement is pending but I can get it tomorrow.

Travel Ops (bot): :information_source: Recommended: mark expense "urgent" if you need off-cycle reimbursement; otherwise it will process on next run.

Liam (Finance): I'll tentatively approve once hospital note arrives. If hospital note cannot be provided for privacy reasons, an attestation from a medical provider or People Ops approval note can suffice.

Daniel (Sales): Thank you 64f I'll add the hospital note. Prefer off-cycle if possible since I paid personally.

expense-bot: :white_check_mark: Expense draft created (ID EXP-6102). Status: awaiting People Ops review and documentation.
